mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_questions), 0) FROM practice_record WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(correct_count), 0) FROM practice_record WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(created_at)) FROM practice_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)

SELECT COALESCE(parent.id, c.id) as categoryId, COALESCE(parent.name, c.name) as categoryName, COALESCE(SUM(r.correct_count), 0) as correctCount, COALESCE(SUM(r.total_questions), 0) as totalCount, CASE WHEN SUM(r.total_questions) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(r.correct_count) * 100.0 / SUM(r.total_questions), 2) ELSE 0 END as correctRate FROM category c LEFT JOIN category parent ON c.parent_id = parent.id LEFT JOIN practice_record r ON c.id = r.category_id AND r.user_id = #{userId} WHERE c.status = 1 GROUP BY COALESCE(parent.id, c.id), COALESCE(parent.name, c.name) ORDER BY MIN(COALESCE(parent.sort, c.sort)), MIN(COALESCE(parent.id, c.id))

SELECT DATE(created_at) as date, COALESCE(SUM(correct_count), 0) as correctCount, COALESCE(SUM(total_questions), 0) as totalCount, CASE WHEN SUM(total_questions) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(correct_count) * 100.0 / SUM(total_questions), 2) ELSE 0 END as correctRate FROM practice_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT COALESCE(parent.name, c.name) as categoryName, COUNT(r.id) as count FROM practice_record r INNER JOIN category c ON r.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN category parent ON c.parent_id = parent.id GROUP BY COALESCE(parent.id, c.id), COALESCE(parent.name, c.name) ORDER BY COUNT(r.id) DESC, COALESCE(parent.name, c.name)
